description: Traffic counts on Israeli roads, 2018-2019 (CBS) is a series of data sets listed in data.gov.il, an open data portal, published or maintained by Central Bureau of Statistics. Coverage: Israel. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its title on the portal is "ספירות תנועה 2018" (Hebrew). The portal files it under the publisher Central Bureau of Statistics. Its tags are הלשכה המרכזית לסטטיסטיקה, ספירות תנועה, תחבורה. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2023-03-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-il-portal.
